stumbles.quote: Thick film sinks in the direction that the phone is tilted
stumbles.why: Unclear what 'thick film' means (parts of the film that are thicker?) and 'sinks in the direction' is ambiguous; it also doesn't say whether the page uses the phone's tilt sensor or what happens on desktop.

stumbles.quote: the film drains at the border until it pops
stumbles.why: Unclear what 'the border' is (the frame edge?) and what 'pops' means visually; does the simulation end or reset?

stumbles.quote: Built on 2026-11-09, it was checked headless on a software GPU and not yet on a real phone.
stumbles.why: 'Built on' a date is odd without context. 'Checked headless on a software GPU' is jargon, and it's unclear what the reader should expect on a real phone, such as whether it might not work.

point: A link to a WebGPU soap-film simulation where tilting your phone makes the thick film flow and drain until it pops, which the author has only tested on a software GPU and not on a real phone.
